root_cause: FF second min(max_bytes,10MiB) and min(explicit/remaining timeout,60) override caller resources before ET accounting.
repair: Forward max_bytes as both raw and decoded body allocation; timeout=min(explicit, parent remaining-cleanup), integer granularity preserved.
boundary: Actual parent remaining<=cleanup+one second stops before key/child.
Actual ET read/time/fee budget remains its sole owner.
Actual measured usage not clamped; no retry after provider/import failure.
ET matching positive timeout support is a required same-node dependency.
